text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
OlympicGames(x) ::: x is an Olympic game.
LastOlympicGames(x) ::: x is the last Olympic games.
HeldIn(x, y) ::: x was held in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in location y.
Tokyo ::: Tokyo is a location.
UnitedStates ::: the United States.
Premises:
SportingEvent(olympicGames) ::: The Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastOlympicGames(olympicGames) ∧ HeldIn(olympicGames, Tokyo) ::: The last Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, Tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
SportingEvent(worldChampionships) ::: The world championships is a sporting event.
